Hardisk Stories est un média hybride pré: Hardisk Stories is a hybrid outlet present both as a podcast and on YouTube, specialising in stories about technology and digital culture. Narrative storytelling is at the heart of its editorial identity: each episode tells a true story from the tech world with the care of an audio documentary.
Un podcast bien produit qui transforme d: A well-produced podcast that turns true stories into near-cinematic narratives. Dynamic voice, punchy editing, immersive soundtrack — it hooks you from the first minute. The stories are researched and sources cited, but the titles sometimes lean too hard on sensationalism. Our verdict: pick and choose. When the subject intrigues you, it's a real pleasure; otherwise the "movie trailer" vibe can feel forced. Not for binge-listening, but for getting swept along when it clicks.
